title: Dark Spots vs Acne Marks: How to Tell the Difference and Care for Each
ex: Acne marks come from pimples; other dark spots come from sun, age or hormones. Learn how to tell them apart and build a gentle routine for both.
rt: Dark Spots vs Acne Marks: What's the Difference? | Mirc Glow
rd: The difference between dark spots and acne marks explained: red marks, PIH, sun spots and melasma, a post-acne skincare routine, and when to see a doctor.
keyword: difference between dark spots and acne marks
quick: Acne marks are flat red, pink or brown spots left after pimples, while dark spots also include sun spots, tanning and melasma. Both are flat, unlike scars. Calm breakouts, use a spot-focused moisturiser at night and wear sunscreen daily for a more even look over 8 to 12 weeks.
facts: Brown acne marks are post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, common on Indian skin.
Dents or raised bumps are scars, not marks, and need a dermatologist.
Sunscreen helps both acne marks and other dark spots look less noticeable.
Picking pimples makes marks darker and longer-lasting.
